process: Carry each prior deduction forward with a matched before/current view and a corrected, reduced, retained or unmeasured disposition. Keep the same foundation scope even when the patch succeeds.

Cast gaze as lead, head as support, and require adaptive attention to release before the authored visitor return and offer. Keep the free hand, question and layout quiet when they carry no active beat.
Review preparation/return/turn/hold together, then inspect the endpoint at intended sizes. Treat purposeful chin/clasp contact differently from incidental crowding.
Check interruption against the displayed staged pose, not only the raw engine pose. Separate control responsiveness from the deliberate character timeline.
Use actual DOM scenes for eyeline, first-view captures for exposure, and simplified films for controlled comparison. State which evidence supports each conclusion.

Use normal-speed observation to judge the offer/flick and repeated-peek questions; use decoded frames and source to locate a failure once observed. Shared vocabulary must not be mistaken for a quality result.
exceptions: Do not compress intentional character content into the sub-300 ms control-feedback budget.
Keep keyboard Play available; the no-keyboard-animation heuristic does not prohibit requested performance content.
Do not replace expressive SVG anatomy merely to satisfy compositor guidance; measure a relevant workload first.
Different subject placements may use different attention directions while anatomy and per-composition light/dark numeric poses remain identical.
Do not automatically delete the second peek, enlarge a mitten, add a wave, exaggerate a corrected gaze, or break an intentional clasp to make an isolated still more explicit.
Do not use website hero rules to erase local review controls during this bounded gesture pass; design the future first view for its actual purpose.

limits: The pair exchange adds no continuous perceptual, physical-phone or unfamiliar-human result.
Tests, browser cases and same-input geometry checks establish their specified mechanics, not live feel or semantic comprehension.
The complete 24-emotion live reel was not watched by A; current source differences, selected sequences and all-current still evidence support the scoped judgment.
Acceptance concerns the implemented local foundation only, without publication or a unanimous 9/10 claim.
